India's FY27 Growth Forecast Slows Amid Global Risks

India's economic growth for fiscal year 2027 is projected to slow to 6.8% from an earlier forecast of 7.6%. This revised forecast is attributed to potential risks including the West Asia crisis and the El Niño weather phenomenon. JPMorgan has also warned of a potential global food and fertilizer crisis in 2027, with potential impacts on India. High food prices have previously been noted as a significant political and economic issue in India.
